items.summary: BOISE, Idaho — Maalik Murphy threw for a career-high 396 yards and three touchdowns, and Jesse Legree caught 12 passes for 140 yards and a score, but Oregon State fell to No. 17 Boise State, 46-41, on Saturday at Albertsons Stadium.

Backup Maalik Murphy threw for 396 yards and three touchdowns, while Jesse Legree racked up 140 receiving yards, but a costly pick-six and defensive breakdowns dropped the Beavers to 5-5.
